title: SBISD Thanksgiving break
description: No school all week. Plan library visits and park days early, since popular spots fill up.

title: Holiday in the Plaza
description: Meet Santa and two of his reindeer, with free professional photos, plus holiday singing and dancing. A donation for the SPCA is welcome. Santa leaves at 4 pm, so arrive on time; weather permitting.
imagePrompt: An outdoor plaza at dusk with a giant decorated Christmas tree and twinkle lights, kids in winter hats meeting a friendly Santa and a reindeer in a small pen, families holding hot cocoa. Cozy and magical.
imageAlt: Illustration: An outdoor plaza at dusk with a giant decorated Christmas tree and twinkle lights, kids in winter hats meeting a friendly Santa and a reindeer in a small pen, families holding hot cocoa

title: SBISD winter break
description: Two weeks off school. We'll round up winter break camps and indoor ideas in December.

title: CityCentre trick-or-treat
description: Trick-or-treat 5–6:45 pm at CityCentre shops and restaurants marked with balloons, then spooky tunes and a performance on the Plaza at 7. Rain or shine; bring a bucket.
imagePrompt: Little kids in costumes with pumpkin buckets trick-or-treating along an outdoor shopping plaza with shops and restaurants, orange balloons marking the doors, parents nearby, late afternoon golden light. Not scary.
imageAlt: Illustration: Little kids in costumes with pumpkin buckets trick-or-treating along an outdoor shopping plaza with shops and restaurants, orange balloons marking the doors, parents nearby, late afternoon golden light

title: Fall Foliage scavenger hunt
description: A free, self-guided scavenger hunt on the trails about fall leaves, any time between 2 and 4 pm. Start at the Nature Center. All ages; wear closed-toe shoes and bring water and bug spray.
imagePrompt: Kids (ages 4–10) with clipboards and crayons on a forest trail, holding up colorful fall leaves to match a scavenger-hunt sheet, parents walking behind. Dappled autumn light.
imageAlt: Illustration: Kids (ages 4–10) with clipboards and crayons on a forest trail, holding up colorful fall leaves to match a scavenger-hunt sheet, parents walking behind

title: Día de los Muertos at the Children's Museum
description: Face painting, ofrenda building and dance performances. Included with museum admission.
imagePrompt: Kids with colorful face paint helping build an ofrenda with marigolds, papel picado and candles at a children's museum, folklórico dancers in bright dresses in the background. Joyful and respectful.
imageAlt: Illustration: Kids with colorful face paint helping build an ofrenda with marigolds, papel picado and candles at a children's museum, folklórico dancers in bright dresses in the background

title: Standing Tall tree festival
description: A kids' zone with tree-themed crafts and activities, plus guided walks to meet the garden's native trees.
imagePrompt: A kids' craft tent in a botanic garden: children making tree crafts and hugging a big oak tree, a guide pointing up at the branches, families on a garden path. Sunny, green, fall day.
imageAlt: Illustration: A kids' craft tent in a botanic garden: children making tree crafts and hugging a big oak tree, a guide pointing up at the branches, families on a garden path

location: Hermann Square at City Hall, 901 Bagby St
title: Mayor's Deck the Hall tree lighting
description: The mayor's holiday tree lighting with live music (En Vogue headlines), family activities, food and a fireworks finale over downtown. Start time not yet announced.
imagePrompt: Families with young kids on a city plaza at night watching a huge holiday tree light up in front of a grand civic building, fireworks above, kids' faces glowing with wonder.
imageAlt: Illustration: Families with young kids on a city plaza at night watching a huge holiday tree light up in front of a grand civic building, fireworks above, kids' faces glowing with wonder

title: Zoo Boo at the Houston Zoo
description: Pumpkins, fall decorations, photo spots and animals getting Halloween treats. Costumes welcome.
imagePrompt: Kids in Halloween costumes (lion, bee, astronaut, witch) walking along a zoo path lined with pumpkins and hay bales, a giraffe in the background, families smiling, sunny fall day. Not scary.
imageAlt: Illustration: Kids in Halloween costumes (lion, bee, astronaut, witch) walking along a zoo path lined with pumpkins and hay bales, a giraffe in the background, families smiling, sunny fall day

title: Scream on the Green
description: Discovery Green's free Halloween night: costume contest, living sculptures, games, spooky music and photo ops.
imagePrompt: A downtown park lawn at dusk with string lights, families and kids in costumes playing lawn games, a costume parade, city skyline in the background. Festive and friendly, not scary.
imageAlt: Illustration: A downtown park lawn at dusk with string lights, families and kids in costumes playing lawn games, a costume parade, city skyline in the background

title: Wings Over Houston Airshow
description: **Rain plan:** flies rain or shine unless severe; no rain date. Big airshow at Ellington with the U.S. Air Force Thunderbirds headlining. Gates at 8 am, flying from about 10:30. Bring ear protection.
imagePrompt: Kids wearing ear-protection headphones sitting on a parent's shoulders, pointing up at jets flying in formation trailing smoke over an airfield. Blue sky, crowd and parked vintage planes.
imageAlt: Illustration: Kids wearing ear-protection headphones sitting on a parent's shoulders, pointing up at jets flying in formation trailing smoke over an airfield

location: Memorial Park, Clay Family Eastern Glades, 6502 Memorial Dr
title: Neighborhood Nights: Holiday Edition
description: A free holiday evening on the lawn: Frozen movie at 6 pm, photos with Santa, Anna and Elsa, letters to Santa, a train ride, cocoa and food trucks. Bring a blanket; no strollers or bikes. Listing end time varies (8 or 9 pm).
imagePrompt: Families on picnic blankets on a park lawn at dusk watching an outdoor movie on a big screen, kids in winter coats holding cups of cocoa, a small toy train and twinkling holiday lights nearby, Santa waving. Cozy and festive.
imageAlt: Illustration: Families on picnic blankets on a park lawn at dusk watching an outdoor movie on a big screen, kids in winter coats holding cups of cocoa, a small toy train and twinkling holiday lights nearby, Santa waving

title: Tyke Hikes en español
description: A Spanish-language nature walk for ages 18 months to 4 with a grown-up: a story, a sensory activity and a stroller-friendly hike. Younger siblings welcome. Parking is $6.50.
imagePrompt: A naturalist leads toddlers and preschoolers with parents along a shady woodland trail, kids pointing at leaves and a pond, strollers on the path. Dappled autumn light, warm and friendly.
imageAlt: Illustration: A naturalist leads toddlers and preschoolers with parents along a shady woodland trail, kids pointing at leaves and a pond, strollers on the path

registration: Each session has its own ticket link on the event page. A second session runs 1–2:30 pm.
title: Homemade Holidays wreath and ornament workshop
description: Make a wreath, ornaments and handmade gifts from grapevine, branches, berries and pinecones with hands-on help. Ages 5 and up with an adult; wear clothes that can get messy.
imagePrompt: Kids (ages 6–10) and parents at long tables in a nature center making wreaths and ornaments from grapevine, pinecones and red berries, greenery everywhere, warm light. Festive and crafty.
imageAlt: Illustration: Kids (ages 6–10) and parents at long tables in a nature center making wreaths and ornaments from grapevine, pinecones and red berries, greenery everywhere, warm light
